results.caption: I’VE LEFT THE UK & MOVED TO DUBAI 🥹✈️🇦🇪 I actually can’t believe I’m writing this… but Dubai is officially our new home 🥹🏡🤍 Oh, and yes… Luna flew to Dubai with us on a private pet jet 😂🐾 a sentence I never thought I’d say!! Thank you for getting us here @petspassport 🤍✈️ Last year, I sold my house, left my corporate job to create a life abroad ✈️ Since then we’ve lived in Marbella, Montenegro + some incredible places… and as exciting (and slightly terrifying 😂) as it’s been, I was definitely ready to unpack properly and have a bit of a base 🏡 So… here we are in DUBAI 🇦🇪🥹 Going from growing up in the UK countryside to waking up surrounded by skyscrapers is going to take some getting used to 😂 but I’m SO excited to find out what it’s really like to live in Dubai, rather than just experience it on holiday I’ll be taking you along as we discover Dubai neighbourhoods, restaurants, hotels, beach clubs + all the unexpected places you might not normally see on social media… with a little bit of luxury along the way, obviously 💅🏼🥂✨ And don’t worry there are plenty of trips, hotel reviews + dream destinations to come too ✈️🌴 I’m feeling excited, nervous, overwhelmed + very ready for this next chapter 🤍 What do you want to see first?! results.transcript: I can't quite believe I'm saying this, but we've left the UK and moved to Dubai. And yes, we flew our dog out with us on a private jet. If you're new here, I'm Ellie. Last year, I sold my house, quit my corporate job, and went all in on building Holidays Club and creating a life abroad. Since then, we've lived in Marbella, Montenegro, and visited some incredible places along the way. It has been the most exciting, fulfilling, and at times terrifying 18 months of my life. But after being consistently on the go, I am definitely ready for a base and a bit of routine. So our next chapter starts here in Dubai. It's almost the complete opposite of the UK countryside where I grew up, which is partly why it excites me and also why it scares me. I want to find out what it's really like to live in Dubai, rather than just experience it on holiday. And I'll be bringing you along as we find the hidden gems, neighbourhoods, restaurants, and unexpected places that might make you look at Dubai differently. With a little luxury along the way, of course. I have no idea what our life here is going to look like or how quickly we'll settle in. But if the last 18 months have taught me anything, it's that I don't need to have everything figured out before taking the next step, and to just trust the process. Two years ago, I was commuting an hour and a half on the M6 to the office. Now this is the view that I'll be waking up to every morning. It all feels completely surreal, but I am just so excited for what's coming next. So if you want to see how the next chapter unfolds, and discover the best of Dubai with me, I'd love you to follow along for the journey. Bye.
